notes: 600 MW, £5bn (Stoics network £15bn: Cato 600 MW, Rufus East Ayrshire 540 MW, Aurelius North Lanarkshire 400 MW, ~1.5 GW total); 'approved Gate 2 grid position' at 600 MW; BiGGAR Economics: 9,660 construction job-years Scotland (1,450 Fife), £708m construction GVA Scotland (£105m Fife), 540 operational jobs Scotland (262 Fife), 120 permanent skilled on-site jobs; water 34,000 m3/yr (=239 homes); construction start expected 2027, five-year phased rollout; ILI CEO Mark Wilson.

title: More than 1,200 objections lodged against £5bn Fife data centre
notes: 1,200+ objections on portal with more expected; 8,000+ signature petition against Auchtertool development; 2,500+ signature petition for Scottish moratorium on hyperscale data centres; Auchtertool Community Council objection ('ill-conceived and inappropriate'); ILI response on renewables/curtailment and separate water infrastructure.

notes: 280,000 m2 hyperscale data centre; six separate buildings with identical footprints for phased construction; 35 m height; architect Graeme Nicholls Architects (Glasgow), involved in all three Stoics projects.

title: ILI files to develop 600MW Stoic data center in Fife, Scotland
notes: Reported 25-hectare development, ~£5bn, delivered in phases over several years. Full article behind 403 to fetcher; figures taken from search-result excerpts — verify against planning documents.

title: Auchtertool data centre — Fife Council has no environmental report
notes: Fife Council (service manager Mary Stewart) concluded EIA not required under 2017 Regulations (Schedule 2 discretion); ACC chair Andrea Cail 'appalled'; Environmental Rights Centre Scotland advised 'credible legal basis for a challenge'; Greens MSP Mark Ruskell called decision 'unfathomable', suggested public inquiry; developer ILI Cato Limited; data halls up to 35 m, substations, security fencing, gatehouses.

title: Over 14,000 responses to plans for massive Auchtertool data centre
publisher: Central Fife Times (Local Democracy Reporting Service)
notes: 14,000–16,000 representations received by 24 Jul 2026 deadline; ~10,000 documents processed for public release; hundreds attended June meeting at Auchtertool Village Hall; SEPA holding objection in July pending further flooding information; Fife Council Head of Planning Pam Ewen quoted.

title: Fife community 'taken aback' at scale of plans for data centre
notes: Auchtertool ~215 houses; three-year build programme cited; ACC chair Andrea Cail quotes on water/discharge/electricity uncertainty; ILI cites cooler climate for 'free cooling' and proximity to wind farms and battery storage; site plans 'up to seven buildings and an on-site substation' (per related search excerpt).

title: Update on Proposed Datacentre Near Auchtertool (community council update, Nov 2025)
perspective: Community council acting as neutral facilitator at that stage
notes: Pre-application stage (Nov 2025): access from B925 west of Auchtertool; ~25% of site visible from most of the village; buildings 30-35 m; developer then indicated 30-50 permanent jobs and up to 1,000 construction jobs; possible district heating; water mains pipe too small, new pipe likely required; Scottish Water Horizons involved; application then targeted for Q1 2026.
